test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

We decided that it would be / too good for you to have / some feminine influence.

options.text: We decided that it would be
too good for you to have

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the phrase "**too good for you to have**."
 
• The phrase **"too good" **typically implies something excessively positive, often leading to a negative consequence or implication, which seems out of place here.
 
• A more appropriate phrase could be "**good for you to have**" without the "too".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We decided that it would be **good **for you to have some feminine influence."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "We decided that it would be," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "some feminine influence."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
